blocks.text: Yeh tab hoti hai jab aabadiyan ek doosre ke saath saath (adjacent) hon lekin ek gradient (aahista aahista badalte mahol) ke saath mukhtalif mahol mein rehti hon. Aabadiyon ke darmiyan gene flow (genes ka len den) kam hota hai, aur har aabadi apne mahol ke mutabiq adaptations bana leti hai. Waqt ke saath is se reproductive isolation ho sakti hai. Misal: ghaas ki species “Anthoxanthum odoratum”, jo ek gradient par mitti ke mukhtalif halaat ke mutabiq mukhtalif adaptations dikhati hai, aur mukhtalif mitti par ugne wali aabadiyon mein reproductive isolation ho jati hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar tareeqe (Allopatric, Peripatric, Parapatric, Sympatric) aur chaar qataarein. Original Population: neela daira. Initial Step: Geographical separation; New Niche; New Niche; Niche differentiation. Reproductive Isolation (naya group hara): In isolation; In isolated niche; In adjacent niche; Within population. Speciation: do ek doosre par chadhe daire, neela aur hara.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har column ko upar se neeche parhein. Neela rang asal species hai aur hara rang nayi banne wali species. Allopatric mein koi jughrafiyai rukawat aabadi ko do mein baant deti hai. Peripatric mein ek chhota group kinare se nikal kar alag jagah ja basta hai. Parapatric mein nayi aabadi saath wale (adjacent) niche mein rehti hai aur gene flow kam hota hai. Sympatric mein nayi species usi ilaqe ke andar banti hai, maslan polyploidy ya niche differentiation se. Aakhri qataar mein dono species alag ho chuki hain.
